title: And Did Those Fleets
lyrics:
And did those fleets in ancient time
Warp into Gliese's system belt:
And was the gravium they found
The source of renewed hope they felt

And did the mining ships of old
Dig deep into the asteroids
And was Xanadu builded here
As people spread across the void

Attune our beams of burning light
Load our tubes with HVLIs
Set all our shield frequencies right
Bring us in range and prep to fire!

We will not cease from astral fight
Nor from our solemn duty hide
Until humanity safely sleeps
In Sol and Gliese all system-wide

title: Forward, UCN
lyrics:
Tongues of fire from stellar flaring
News of foemen near declaring
To heroic deeds of daring
Call you, UCN

Groans of wounded people dying
Wails of parents and kids flying
For the distant succour crying
Call you, UCN

Shall the voice of wailing
Now be unavailing
You to rouse who never yet
In battle's hour were failing

This our answer, ships in warping
Swift as stellar winds a-roaring
Not in vain the voice imploring
Calls the UCN

Loud the red alert is sounding
Hearts of every crew are bounding
Captains briefing plans astounding
Fly we, UCN

Short, the sleep the foe is taking
Ere the morrow's morn is breaking
They shall have a rude awakening
From the UCN

title: Song of the Frontline
lyrics:
Come, cheer up, my crew, 'tis to glory we steer
To add something new to this wonderful year;
To honour we call you, the best of our race
For who are so free as those out here in space

Chorus:
Hulls of steel are our ships,
Of the bold UCN
We always stand ready - steady, crew, Steady!
We'll fight and we'll beat 'em again and again

We ne'er see our foes across the vastness of space
They never see us as they don't dare to face
If they run, why we follow at warp factor 3
For the chase is an action we all love to see

Repeat chorus

They say they'll invade us, our bold enemies,
The pirates, rogue factions and UVPs,
But if they in their hulls plan any attack
We of this task group will push them right back

Repeat chorus

We still make them fear and we still make them flee
We'll meet them in space to beat easily
Then cheer up my crew with this message to send
Our cadets, our captains to our president

Repeat chorus

title: The Cobalt Flag
tune: O Tannenbaum; trad (AKA The Red Flag)
lyrics:
The UCN flag flies in space
A symbol of the human race
In venturing we shall be bold
Through void of space both dark and cold

Chorus:
So let the Cobalt Banner fly
From star to star across the sky
What perils face us we don't know
In the beyond where we must go

From many nations of the Earth
Confederation had its birth
Then Luna, moving on to Mars
And then beyond to reach the stars

Repeat chorus

For friends we find across the belt
Felicitations truly felt
With efforts bold and allies true
We proudly fly our banner blue

Repeat chorus

From nebula storm or astral rocks
We'll brook no temporal paradox
Events must happen now and then
We'll do before what's done again

Repeat chorus

Across the void our ships shall range
Locating dangers dire and strange
Time and again our crews come back
To face what lurks out in the black

Repeat chorus

We came for peace, prepared for war
We face a foe like none before
On this we are all of one mind
We'll leave no officer behind

Repeat chorus

Though war has cost us many a friend
We will not falter, break or bend
Unwavering we all shall be
We fight for all humanity

Repeat chorus

[Unofficial Extra Verse]
The President has words in store
We've heard them many times before
It's gravium we seek of course
It is a limited resource

Repeat chorus

title: The Fleet
tune: Marching Through Georgia; Henry Clay Work
lyrics:
Sound the call to battle stations, sound it far and wide
Flanks speed forth to combat now, our crewmates by our side
Our enemies will flee in vain, there's nowhere they can hide
From the fleet that fights for all peoples

Chorus:
The fleet, the fleet
It's Roger Taylor's fleet
The fleet, the fleet
A force that can't be beat
We've orders to defend the belt, no chance of a retreat
By the fleet that fights for all peoples

Hark! The signals coming from the east and from the west
Our allies now are warping in, we fight with renewed zest
United we shall stand together, formed up from the best
As a fleet that is drawn from all peoples

Repeat chorus

We stand foursquare for liberty, all peoples must be free
None of us shall falter from the fight, tho' stern it be
And the Cobalt Flag we love shall fly for all to see
'Cross a belt that is free for all peoples

Repeat chorus

The fleet, it now is charging on, the battle to begin,
Our voices now are raised on high above the battle's din,
We'll never cease from fighting 'til the victory we win,
And the belt is free for all peoples

Repeat chorus

title: Those In Peril In the Void
tune: Eternal Father, Strong to Save; John Bacchus Dykes
lyrics:
Oh noble comrades, bold and brave
Who seek those souls that we must save
Patrolling throughout charted space
Protectors of the human race
Our duty we shall not avoid
To those in peril in the void

As dangerous forces now appear
And innocents call out in fear
Unwavering, our crews respond
The cry of all to Go Beyond
Our duty we shall not avoid
To those in peril in the void

So many stations they assail
Divided we cannot prevail
Where once were factions, now you see
We fight as one to keep us free
Our duty we shall not avoid
To those in peril in the void

Though vicious forces now attack
The UCN will drive them back
From cell to cell our fleet will win
UVPs out, the Navy in
The frontline's where we'll be deployed
'til freedom reigns across the void

title: Auld Lang Syne
words: Lt. Cmdr. Jim - Ship's Councillor (adapted from Robert Burns)
lyrics:
Should old acquaintance be forgot
And never brought to mind
Should old acquaintance be forgot
And auld lang syne?

Chorus:
For auld lang syne, my dear
For auld lang syne
We'll take a tot of kindness yet
For auld lang syne

And surely you'll buy your rum tot
(Unless they're out of lime)
And we'll take a tot o' kindness yet
For auld lang syne

Repeat chorus

We crew have warped about these skies
And seen such sites sublime
But we've travelled many a parsec cold
Since auld lang syne

Repeat chorus

We crew have faced foes bold and strange
Across all space and time
But we've been scattered 'cross the void
Since auld lang syne

Repeat chorus

And there's a hand my trusty friend
And give me a hand o' thyne
And we'll take a right good-will draught
For auld lang syne

Repeat chorus

title: Ballad of the UCS Havock
lyrics:
He was just a rookie ensign, fresh off the transporter pad
He boarded the starship Havock, with adventures to be had
The captain, brave and grizzled, gave a nod and a sly wink,
He'll be back to the belt for sure!

Chorus:
Glory, glory, Havock's a hell of a ship to fly,
Glory, glory, Havock's a hell of a ship to fly,
Glory, glory, Havock's a hell of a ship to fly,
He'll be back to the belt for sure!

The plucky crew they cheered him, as he strapped into his seat,
A new adventure waiting, a brand-new foe to meet.
They set a course and jumped to warp, the stars began to blur,
He'll be back to the belt for sure!

Repeat chorus

As they travelled through the Adamas Belt the pirates laid their evil trap,
The Havock's shields were tested, with nary time to nap.
The battle raged and cannons roared, a fight to hold their ground,
He'll be back to the belt for sure!

Repeat chorus

The warp core starts to shudder, with a blinding flash of red,
"Shields Down!" cried the ensign, filled with growing sense of dread.
They wrestled with the systems, as the sparks began to fly,
He'll be back to the belt for sure!

Repeat chorus

With skill and steady courage, the ensign saved the day,
The Havock limped to safety, escaping from harm's way.
The captain looked upon his crew with a proud and knowing grin,
He'll be back to the belt for sure!

Repeat chorus

Back on board the Warspite, where the dispatches were read
A shiny new promotion, upon the ensign's head.
From rookie to Lieutenant, a hero through and through,
He'll be back to the belt for sure!

title: Battle Hymn of the UCN
tune: Battle Hymn of the Republic; trad
lyrics:
We are the Warspite Task Group and we always do our best
We can fly and fight and explore and we hardly need to rest
And when we’ve done our crewing we stick medals to our vest
And we’ll just keep flying on…

Chorus:
Glory to the UCN
Glory to the UCN
Glory to the UCN
And we’ll always Go Beyond!

We have the Takanami, she’s a big ship strong and true
But you want to go quickly we’ve a sorry tale for you
But why people dislike her, why we haven’t got a clue
So we’ll just keep flying on…

Repeat chorus

We’ve also got the Havock, she a fast ship of the fleet
And the railings on the bridge help keep the Captain in their seat
But while she is not that powerful, she still is really neat
And we’ll just keep flying on…

Repeat chorus

Our friends are Terra Novans they are nice and kind and fair
We don’t know where their planet is, and we don’t really care
Because they make such lovely food they always like to share
So we’ll just keep flying on…

Repeat chorus

Then there’s the Grey Hat Hackers they’re a nasty piece of work
Their drones are real annoying and their Boss talks like a jerk
So we’ll blow up all their ships and we will do it with a smirk
Then we’ll just keep flying on…

Repeat chorus

There’s the scary Cult of Torment, they like throwing things to space
They really are quite crazy and we’ll say it to their face
Because killing people’s not on so we’ll put them in their place
And we’ll just keep flying on…
repeat chorus

They came in from the Barrens, they're the scary UVPs!
All the Vipers want to do is bring all humans to their knees,
But we're not gonna give up, we're as daring as you please,
So we'll just keep fighting on…

Repeat chorus

We hang out in the Mess to get some lovely R&R
But the coinage of an officer don’t really stretch that far
So we play games, laugh and sing and order nice drinks from the bar
Then we’ll just keep flying on…

Repeat chorus

title: Bones in the Void
tune: Bones in the Ocean; The Longest Johns
lyrics:
Oh, I bid farewell to the yards and to Mars
And I fly away from the Earth and the Sun
To search for those we have gone lost to the void
To search for the place I hear all spacers end

As the souls of the dead fill the space of my mind
I'll search without sleeping 'til peace I can find
I fear not the storms, I fear not the void
I remember the fallen, do they think of me?
When their bones in the long dark forever will be

Plot a course to the belt to a place I once knew
To a place where my hope died along with my crew
So I swallow my grief and face life's final test
To find promise of peace and the solace of rest

As the songs of the dead fill the space of my ears
Their laughter like children, their beckoning cheers
My heart longs to join them, sings songs in the mess.
I remember the fallen, do they think of me?
When their bones in the long dark forever will be

When at last before my ghostly crew there I stand
I shed a small tear for my home far away
Though their eyes show a darkness of struggle and strife
Their smiles below say I don't owe them my life

As the souls of the dead fill the space of my eyes
And my ship vents the atmo and gives its goodbyes
I'm this far from floating, right into the void
I remember the living, do they think of me?
When my bones in the long dark forever will be

Now that I'm staring right into the darkest abyss
I'm not sure what I want, but I don't think it's this
As my comrades call to stand fast and forge on
I make haste for the fleet till the darkness has gone

As the souls of the dead live for'er in my mind
As I live all the years that they left me behind
I'll stay on the ship but still gaze at the void
I remember the fallen and they think of me
For our souls in the long dark together will be

I remember the fallen and they think of me
For our souls in the long dark together will be

title: Cry Havock
lyrics:
The Havock is a noble ship,
A ship of high renown,
The darling of the UCN,
The jewel in the crown,
The pride of every engineer,
The captain's favourite craft,
Destroyers try to pass her
And all we do is laugh!

Chorus:
(And it's)
Strike swift, strike sure,
Wheel about, come in again and
Strike hard, strike true
And send them on their way.

Pirates come for plunder,
They think they've won their prize
But the Havock's right behind them
What a terrible surprise!
Springing from the nebula,
With thunder in her eye,
You can see the starlight glinting,
You can hear the gunners' cry!

Repeat chorus

And when we're on Arcadia
The bars kick up a fuss
You've never seen what Havock means
Until you've drunk with us,
But when they say 'why won't you stay?'
We all reply 'What for?
We Havocks all are barking mad
Cos we're the dogs of war!'

Repeat chorus

title: Deep Space Submarine
lyrics:
When we're damaged in a fight
it upsets the engineer
but the risk we might implode
means they'll do what they most fear

Once the switch has been engaged
we'd better hope we don't have to flee
'coz without a quantum drive
our top speed is strictly sub-c

Chorus:
We're all stuck in a deep space submarine
a deep space submarine, a deep space submarine
We're all stuck in a deep space submarine
a deep space submarine, a deep space submarine

So we're floating here in space
hanging out with nowhere to go
how we wish we'd brought some games
while we're waiting for a tow

Repeat chorus

But at least we should be glad
that the designers installed some beds
we would have a crummy time
with nowhere to rest our heads

Repeat chorus

So I hope we brought some snacks
or we're really up the creek
we're all stuck out here alone
until we're picked up sometime next week

Repeat chorus

title: (Do Not) Pull the Lever
tune: Leave Her, Johnny, Leave Her; trad
lyrics:
At the heart of the ship there's a crucial site
Lever, it's a lever
And the ensigns want to know what it's like
But please do not pull the lever

Chorus:
Do not pull the lever,
Oh do not pull the lever
For the voyage is long if you're at sublight
Which you'll be if you pull the lever

Our TO pointed at this control:
"Lever, it's the lever"
"You should fix the drive if it's going to blow"
"But please do not pull the lever"

Repeat chorus

When J.U.D.I.T.H. alerts please do not take fright
Do not pull the lever
Just switch the right switches, it'll be all right
But please do not pull the lever

Repeat chorus

If the countdown's low and the drive's awry
Maybe pull the lever
'Cause if it implodes then we all might die
So it's time to pull the lever

Lever, pull the lever
Oh lever, pull the lever
And the aft of the ship fills with safety smoke
When you pull the lever

title: Don't Explode
lyrics:
Oh, the pirates outside are frightful,
But our missiles are so delightful,
And since we're out on our own,
Don't explode, Don't explode, Don't Explode

Crew, they don't show signs of stopping
And the warp core is almost popping,
Red Alert is in full effect
Don't explode, Don't Explode.

With our beams going at full might,
And the impulse pushed to its peak
It makes for an interesting flight,
But the power levels look quite bleak

Now their shields are slowly dying,
And my crew, we're still surviving
As long we send them going,
And Don't explode, Don't Explode, Don't Explode

As we finally turn the tide,
As they try to run to that moon
We'll give them a full broadside
And be back at the Warspite so soon,

And the pirates are finally done,
But not all of our damage is gone,
Just as long our Chief works on,
We won't explode, won't explode, won't explode

title: Fleet Admiral
lyrics:
Last night we went soaring, soaring through deep space
Last night we were wowed by this former Intelligence ace
She said "Don't you dare eject the warp core"
Unless core implosion is dangerously close.

Chorus:
Who should get promoted? We cried "Moore, Moore, Moore!"
Never stop promoting Freddie Moore, Moore, Moore.
To the top of the UCN, Moore, Moore, Moore!
There's none we trust more than Freddie Moore, Moore, Moore.
Moore, Moore, Moore!

She's the thoroughly capable, she knows what to do.
And if it came to it she'd risk life for her crew.
She does the right thing, she won't get us scammed.
She does the right thing, Intelligence be damned.

Repeat chorus

We fly on our own missions
Got the clear to go from ship's physician.
We'll fly all night follow an ICM hunch.
Just as long, just as long we're back for lunch.

[Kazoo solo]

Who trains the best, it's Freddie.
Who's trained them all, it's Freddie.
Who did the right thing, it's Freddie.
A million times, it's Freddie.
We fly with you, it's Freddie.
We've mad respect for Freddie.
Nothing but respect for Freddie.
We give our all, for Freddie.
Just to, just to, just to, just to, have you make it to the top.

Repeat chorus

Oh yeah promote Freddie
The best we've got
Moore, Moore, Moore, Moore, Moore (Moore)

Come on promote Freddie
She deserves more
Moore, Moore, Moore, Moore, Moore (Moore)

title: Fly Again
tune: The Mary Ellen Carter; Stan Rogers
lyrics:
She was boarded during Wargames, she was wracked by Uvie beams
The skipper gave themselves up, to thwart their evil schemes
A sense of duty unsurpassed, they knew they had to go
Their loss had dealt us all a mighty blow

The evacuation shuttles launched, though some marines were lost
Most of the crew was safe then, but still we count the cost
And when we heard the Herald's voice, it caused us to proclaim
That the Falchion and her captain'll fly again

Now Hamilton's beloved, there's no price that we won't spend
After such distinguished service, we won't let this be their end
But with frontline battles raging, from Horizon to Sca Fell
We've got to fight the wider war as well

But we talked of them on CommsNet, every day around the clock
We need to get them back and then to Harden and the docs
And with every jar that hit the bar, we swore we would remain
And make sure Falchion and her captain fly again

Chorus:
Fly again, fly again!
Let their names be ever spoken throughout the UCN
Those who love them best and will be with 'em 'til the end
Will make sure Falchion and her captain fly again

The Falchion's at Kalgoorlie now, her hull all warped and bent
Three shifts a day are working on her, not to mention Dent
But even if we're short on parts, and fixing her is slow
Our plan to rescue Hamilton's a go

The intel's sound, crews inbound, the Tak and Havock prepped
The Herald's ship's been spotted and we're poised to intercept
Tomorrow then, our ships deploy, our mission here is plain
To make sure Falchion and her captain fly again

Repeat chorus

We couldn't leave them there, you see, transformed and as a slave
They've saved our lives so many times, a captain bold and brave
And the alien foes who kidnapped them, and carried them away
Will find they've made a grave mistake today

And you, to whom adversity has dealt the final blow
With vicious bastards shooting at you everywhere you go
Turn to, and put out all your strength of arm and heart and brain
And like the Falchion and her captain, fly again

Fly again, fly again!
Though your heart it be broken, or life about to end
No matter what you've lost, be it a home, a love, a friend
Then like the Falchion and her captain fly again

Fly again, fly-y-y again!
Though your heart it be broken, or life about to end
No matter what you've lost, be it a home, a love, a friend
Like the Falchion and her captain fly again

title: Garotte's Buccaneers
lyrics:
O the year was twenty one eighty two
How I wish I was on Xanadu now
A letter of marque came from the Gliese
To the scummiest vessel I've ever seen

Chorus:
God damn them all
I was told we'd cruise the belt for lost Jasa gold
We'd fire no beams, shed no tears
Now I'm a broken man with no cocktail here
The last of Garotte's Buccaneers

O Elcid Garotte cried the town
How I wish I was on Xanadu now
For 20 good spacers void trained who
Would make for him the Antelope's crew

Repeat chorus

The Antelope sloop was a sickening sight
How I wish I was on Xanadu now
She'd list to the port and a deck that sags
And the cook in the scuppers with the staggers and jags

Repeat chorus

On Alta's birthday we put to space
How I wish I was on Xanadu now
Too many hours to find our prey
Juggling coolant all the way

Repeat chorus

When the second watch woke we sailed again
How I wish I was on Xanadu now
When a UCN freighter hove in sight
With our cracked torp-tubes we made to fight

Repeat chorus

The UCN weighed down with tin
How I wish I was on Xanadu now
She was broad and fat and slow as heck
And to catch her took the Antelope two parsecs

Repeat chorus

Then at length she stood two sectors away
How I wish I was on Xanadu now
Our cracked torp tubes made awful din
With one fat missile they stove us in

Repeat chorus

The Antelope shook and pitched on her side
How I wish I was on Xanadu now
Garotte was smashed like a bowl of eggs
A lethal beam carried off both me legs

Repeat chorus

Now here I lay in my twenty-third year
How I wish I was on Xanadu now
It's been two months since we sailed away
And I just made Roma yesterday

Repeat chorus

title: Hey J.U.D.I.T.H
lyrics:
Hey J.U.D.-I.T.H., don't be mad
Here's some coolant to make it better
The engin-eers have got the spare parts
And they will start to make it better

Hey J.U.D.-I.T.H., don't be 'fraid
You were made to keep us safe here
When crystals regenerate on your plinth
Then you begin to make it better

And any time the crew exclaim, "J.U.D.I.T.H., refrain"
don't give too much weight to their moaning.
For well you know that it's a fool who can't keep cool
Just because power conduits smoulder

Na na na nananana, nannana

Hey J.U.D.-I.T.H., shields are down
We're low power, need a new fuel cell
We'll get one, and swap it into your heart
Then you can start to make it better.

With smoky air and sparks flying, J.U.D.I.T.H., begin,
You're waiting for someone to repair with.
And don't you know that it's just you, J.U.D.I.T.H., you'll do,
The fuses we need are in your lockers.

Na na na nananana, nannana

Hey J.U.D.-I.T.H., don't be mad
Here's some coolant to make it better
When crystals regenerate on your plinth
Then you begin to make it

Better better better better better better, oh.

Na na na nananana, nannana, hey Jude...
(repeat and fade)

title: I Stole the Takanami (For Educational Purposes Only)
lyrics:
How, how do I fly the Takanami?
(The question's real, I stole the Takanami)
Close the airlock, make sure it's fully sealed.
(I stole the Takanami)
Undock from Warspite and manoeuvre her at impulse.
(I stole the Takanami)
Get a bearing from nav and set yourself a course in.
(I stole the Takanami)
Push to warp one and watch the lines streaking.
(I stole the Takanami)
Check the heat, warp drive will need some coolant
(I stole the Takanami)
Increase to warp 2 and hear the engine purrin'
(I stole the Takanami)
Don't mind JUDITH if you're burning through power
(I stole the Takanami)
Come out of warp afore you hit your destination
(I stole the Takanami)
Open up comms and request for docking.
(I stole the Takanami)
With impulse engines manoeuvre til docking's ready.
(I stole the Takanami)
Auto dock then it's time to get the drinks in
(I stole the Takanami)
(I stole the Takanami)

title: Into the Void
tune: Into the West; Annie Lennox, Howard Shore
lyrics:
Lay down
Your sweet and weary head
Night has fallen
You have come to journey's end
Sleep now
As you meet the ones who came before
They are calling
From beyond the stars

Please do not weep
Have not these tears upon your face?
For you were brave
For you braver than you know
Sibling in arms
You can sleep long now

Chorus:
What can you see
Out in those stars?
What was your call to explore?
Across the void
The nebula gleam
The ships have come to carry you home

And all will turn
Back to stardust
A light in the darkness
All souls pass

Set sail
Into the world of night
Through darkness falling
Out of scanner range and sight

Don't say
We have come now to the end
The unknown's calling
You and I will meet again
Beloved sibling in arms
Just sleep now

Repeat chorus

And all will turn
Back to stardust
A light in the darkness
Blue ships pass

Into the void

title: Join Me, My Friends
lyrics:
[v1 - Arrival at Gliese 667Cc]

Join me my friends, join with me.
As we fly ever on, from that we know
Away from our homes, on land or in space
Let us sing for those gone far behind us

For all of that beauty and joy we left
Wild blue oceans, and stars above
For all those we knew, and those that won't
We sing of our hope that something must go on

Join me my friends, join with me
As we fly ever on, from that we know
Away from our homes, to something new
Let our song give us hope for we must press on,

Join me my friends, join with me, in song

[v2 - Returning to the Adamas]

Join me my friends, join with me.
As we fly ever on, for new discoveries
Away from our homes, on land or in space
Let us sing of that system we hope to aid

Far out into the void of space,
Lies the trinary that we once knew
For all it may aid us, it is still far
And the journey is long but we do it for home

Join me my friends, join with me
As we fly ever on, to new mysteries,
Back to the Adamas, back to our hope,
Let us sing of new sights and treasures beyond

Join me my friends, join with me, back there

[v3 - Back in the Adamas]

Join me my friends, join with me.
As we fly ever on, for new discoveries
Finding a new home, out among friends
Let us sing of that system we hope to aid

From wild blue oceans, red sands or stars
We all share a bond that can't be torn apart
Sing for our fellows both new and old
For space takes us all no matter how bold

Join me my friends, join with me
As we fly ever on, to new mysteries,
Back in the Adamas, back to our hope,
Let us sing with our new friends and for discoveries

Join me my friends, join with me, out there

title: Leave Earth, Johnny
tune: Leave Her, Johnny, Leave Her; trad
lyrics:
I thought I heard the Admiral say:
"Leave Earth, Johnny, leave Earth."
Tomorrow we will find our way,
and it's time for us to leave Earth.

Chorus:
Leave Earth, Johnny, leave Earth!
Oh, leave Earth, Johnny, leave Earth!
For the skies are dark and the grass won't grow
And it's time for us to leave Earth.

Oh, the warnings came but we stayed too long.
Leave Earth, Johnny, leave Earth!
The scientists said it all along.
And it's time for us to leave Earth.

Repeat chorus

Look at the size of the Exodus fleet!
Leave Earth, Johnny, leave Earth!
Five factions sailing in retreat
And it's time for us to leave Earth.

Repeat chorus

We sail into the void to start anew.
Leave Earth, Johnny, leave Earth!
The Adamas Belt is what we pursue.
And it's time for us to leave Earth.

Repeat chorus

title: My Dear [Ship Name]
tune: The Song of the Western Men; Louisa T Clare
lyrics:
A good ship full of trusty hands
Well train-ed, brave and true
The President shall understand
